{
  "name": "claude-image-generation",
  "version": "2026.9.1",
  "description": "Generate and edit images using Google Gemini, OpenAI GPT Image, xAI Grok Image, and OpenRouter APIs",
  "author": {
    "name": "hex",
    "url": "https://github.com/hex"
  },
  "repository": "https://github.com/hex/claude-image-generation",
  "license": "MIT",
  "keywords": [
    "image-generation",
    "gemini",
    "openai",
    "gpt-image",
    "xai",
    "grok-image",
    "openrouter",
    "text-to-image",
    "image-editing"
  ],
  "userConfig": {
    "defaultProviders": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Default providers",
      "description": "Which providers the generate tool runs when a call names none. \"all\" runs gemini, openai and xai in parallel; openrouter is opt-in.",
      "required": false,
      "default": "all",
      "options": [
        "all",
        "gemini",
        "openai",
        "xai",
        "openrouter"
      ]
    },
    "outputDir": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Output directory",
      "description": "Where the generate tool saves images when a call gives no outputBase, relative to the session's working directory.",
      "required": false,
      "default": "."
    }
  }
}
